title: Prusa Connect Offline Gap
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prusaconnect:printer
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by printer
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Prusa Connect status updates telemetry to monitor how long printers have been quiet in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for printers that fell off the network or cloud view, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Prusa Connect status updates data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Printer table of hours since last contact.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long printers have been quiet so you can spot printers that fell off the network or cloud view before it becomes annoying.
